title: Use your own catalog

scenes.heading: Your component belongs in the recipe
scenes.sub: Add your private configuration as data
voice: Your internal Kubernetes service needs a component your team maintains.
Put its registry entry and an overlay in a catalog directory so AICR can resolve it.

scenes.heading: Choose how the catalog is loaded
scenes.sub: Layer it or supply the entire catalog
voice: Point the data flag at your directory to layer it over the embedded catalog.
If you supply a complete catalog, external only chooses that data by itself.

scenes.heading: Catch mistakes while they are cheap
voice: Run recipe validate against the catalog.
For example, a reference to an absent component gives you a diagnostic while you are still working on the data.

scenes.heading: Render the component into the bundle
scenes.detail: Supply the same data when bundling
voice: Select the catalog when you resolve the recipe and again when you bundle it.
The generated files now describe the private component your deployment tool needs to apply.

viewer: Integrator with a private Kubernetes service
payoff: Validate a private catalog and carry one custom runtime component from an overlay into the generated bundle.
